name: Query
description: Run a stored slug-based query or a raw SQL query and expose the result as a named DataFrame inside the MultiQS pipeline.
usage: Add entries to the top-level ``queries:`` block. Each key is the DataFrame name; each value must specify either ``slug`` (named stored query) or ``query`` (raw SQL). For raw SQL, set either ``driver`` (e.g. ``pg``, ``mysql``) or ``datasource`` (named connection). Any additional keys on a ``slug`` entry are passed through as conditions.

attributes.name: slug
attributes.description: Stored query slug to execute. Mutually exclusive with ``query``.

attributes.name: query
attributes.description: Raw SQL string to execute. Mutually exclusive with ``slug``.

attributes.name: driver
attributes.description: Default driver to use when running a raw ``query`` (e.g. ``pg``, ``mysql``, ``bigquery``).

attributes.name: datasource
attributes.description: Named datasource (connection) to use when running a raw ``query``. Takes precedence over ``driver``.

attributes.name: remote
attributes.description: When ``True``, dispatch this query to a remote qworker server instead of executing locally. Requires either a ``worker`` key on the same entry or the central ``QWORKER_HOST`` / ``QWORKER_PORT`` configuration.

attributes.name: worker
attributes.description: Address of the remote qworker to use for this query, in ``host:port`` format (e.g. ``qworker1.internal:8888``). Overrides the central ``QWORKER_HOST`` / ``QWORKER_PORT`` settings. Only relevant when ``remote: true``. If no port is specified, QWORKER_PORT is used as the fallback (default: 8888).

attributes.name: tenant
attributes.description: Tenant owner for this query. If omitted, inherits from parent or uses the configured default store. If explicitly ``null``, uses the legacy store. If a string, selects that exact tenant from the allowlist. Examples: ``null`` (legacy), ``client_a`` (explicit tenant).

attributes.name: pre-hook
attributes.description: SQL (a string or a list of strings) run BEFORE this query's retrieval, isolated on the write (DB*) credentials in its own transaction — never on, or in a transaction shared with, the read. PostgreSQL ``queries`` entries only (slug on the ``db``/``pg`` provider, or raw ``driver`` ``pg``/``postgres``/``postgresql`` without ``datasource``); requires the ``datasource:use`` grant on ``pg_admin``. Guarded: DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER … DROP, DO, GRANT/REVOKE, role DDL, COPY … PROGRAM and transaction control are rejected. If it fails the query is not read. Never accepted from request conditions.

attributes.name: post-hook
attributes.description: SQL (a string or a list of strings) run AFTER this query's retrieval, isolated on the write (DB*) credentials in its own transaction — never on, or in a transaction shared with, the read. It runs after a successful OR empty (no data / 204) retrieval, but NOT after a failed one; an empty result is still reported as "no data". PostgreSQL ``queries`` entries only (slug on the ``db``/``pg`` provider, or raw ``driver`` ``pg``/``postgres``/``postgresql`` without ``datasource``); requires the ``datasource:use`` grant on ``pg_admin``. Guarded: DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER … DROP, DO, GRANT/REVOKE, role DDL, COPY … PROGRAM and transaction control are rejected. Never accepted from request conditions.

json_schema.description: A single entry under the MultiQS ``queries:`` block. Must provide either ``slug`` or ``query`` (but not both).
